prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble, in real places. Projected across the whole scene, coloured oil and water swim like a 1960s liquid light show: huge soft-edged blobs of amber, magenta and cobalt blue drift over the faces, suits and brick walls, merging and splitting, with thin dark rims where oil meets water. Underneath, the scene stays real: in a smoky basement dance hall a tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache dances arm in arm with a ginger man with mutton-chop whiskers and a red carnation, and a woman with a black bob in a plain blue cardigan with a blue carnation, all three laughing. Camera at hip height, between the legs of a band in pinstripe suits in the foreground. Light: one white spotlight from above. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
